# wall_correction_validity_floor

Axis A6, bounding `bead_centre_height`.

**The bound, in words.** The bead's centre sits high enough above the coverslip that the parallel wall correction used to read the drag is accurate to what its entry states; closer in, the series underestimates the drag.
